commit_note: The two arms' images were built at different commits - 3b8c8f9 and 7aec5f0 - because the A image was already on the board from the control run and was not reflashed. NO firmware source differs between those commits: the diff is CLAUDE.md and two records files, and fw_layout is 184f18dfdcb9ade0 on this A image exactly as on the earlier ones. The knob is still the track alone. Caught by the fw_repo_rev field rather than by remembering, which is what it is for.
means: At the sample size windows-desk used, the two tracks share NO site at any wait state: 0 of 29 in union, jaccard 0.000. The single shared bin at n=12 (226 at FWS 4) does not survive the larger sample and was marginal. Against a same-track ceiling of 0.45 to 0.63 on this bench, the two tracks are completely disjoint - which is the strongest form of the result and it is stronger than what was published at n=12.
not_claimed: Anything about severity. These are site sets.
